name: eeprom_load_config
exceptional_convention: uses fixed OS EEPROM services 0x184 and 0x24E

name: setup_infopanel
exceptional_convention: calls fixed draw_string/copy services through A2 = 0x25A and A3 = 0x142

name: player_join
exceptional_convention: reads the low byte of the first normal stack slot at A6+0xB

name: player_start_inner
return: D0.l = -1 when placement and MOB initialization succeed, or 0 when no usable spawn position exists

name: secret_bonus_earned
return: D0.l = -1 when the current secret-task/progress state earns the secret-room coin bonus, else 0

name: player_activecount
return: D0.l = count (0..4) of player statuses 1, 2, 8, or 0x10
